name: Tranceweaver
equipped_with: A Tranceweaver is equipped with: Ravaging claws.
abilities: Deepstrike, Daemon, Daemonic instability, Mark of Slaanesh, Squadron, Terrifying(-1)
Entourage: For each Greater Daemon of the same Chaos god, one unit with this rule can be can be chosen that does not occupy an HQ slot.
